info.name: SkinLookBD API Documentation
info.description: REST API for the SkinLookBD skincare storefront, admin dashboard, and mobile clients.

Updates name and/or email. Phone number changes go through the OTP
verification flow instead and are not editable here.

Fails with a 422 if the category still has products assigned to it.

item.name: Admin - Dashboard
item.description:
Requires the `super-admin` or `order-manager` role. "Revenue" counts orders in
`confirmed`, `processing`, `shipped`, or `delivered` status only.

request.description:
Revenue totals for today/this week/this month, order counts by status, and
a low-stock variant count.

Daily revenue and order counts over a date range (`from`/`to`, default: last
30 days).

Best sellers by units sold over an optional date range, limited to `limit`
(default 10) results.

Applies a positive or negative quantity change to a variant's stock and
records an `InventoryLog` entry. Rejected with a 422 if it would push stock
below zero.
Lists variants at or below a stock threshold (default 5), lowest first.
Filterable by `status`, `user_id`, and a `from`/`to` date range.

Enforces the lifecycle: `pending` → `confirmed` → `processing` → `shipped` →
`delivered`, with `cancelled` reachable from any pre-shipped state. Marking an
order `delivered` also marks a COD payment as `paid`. `returned` is only
reachable via the refund endpoint.

Only allowed when the order has a `confirmed` or `paid` payment and is not
already `cancelled`/`returned`. Marks the payment `refunded`, restocks
inventory, and sets the order status to `returned`.
The code is normalized to uppercase.

Unlike the public endpoint, returns every banner regardless of active state
or date window.

item.name: Cart
item.description:
Works for both guests and authenticated customers. Guests are tracked via an
`X-Cart-Token` header: send it back on every request once you've received it
from a response, and it merges into the customer's cart automatically on login.

Validates stock, applies an optional coupon, computes the shipping charge for
the chosen address, and atomically creates the order, order items, and payment
record, decrementing variant stock and clearing the cart.

Only allowed while the order is `pending` or `confirmed`. Restocks the
reserved inventory.

after a staff member has phoned the customer to verify the order. Restricted
to `super-admin` and `order-manager` roles.
